_comment: Paths are relative to this file. assets_dir holds the cleaned files; references_dir holds scenario.md, phase-prompts.md, gates.md and answer-key.md; seed_content is optional. Optional: app_id (keep the same GUID across versions), plugin.color_icon / plugin.outline_icon (paths to your own 192x192 and 32x32 PNGs). Bump version for every re-release. files_per_asset_skill (default 18, max 19) caps sample files per generated <kit>-assets-N skill (files are stored as base64 JSON; payload also capped at about 9.5 MB per skill). No archives: list the files themselves; each must be under about 3.5 MB.

plugin.name_full: Caldova Insurance Legal Demo – UC4 MGA Onboarding
plugin.desc_short: Fictional MGA appointment demo using the Legal for Cowork skills
plugin.desc_full: A self-contained demo kit for Copilot Cowork. It deploys 23 fictional deal files for Caldova Insurance's appointment of Northpoint Specialty Underwriters as a managing general agent for a five-state small-business cyber program, plus sample emails, Teams messages and calendar entries, to a SharePoint site or OneDrive folder you choose. It checks that the 20 Legal for Cowork skills are installed, then walks a presenter through six phases and five human approval gates: diligence, precedent playbook, regulatory structuring, negotiation of the MGA's markup, committee approval and execution readiness, and go-live obligations. Requires the Legal for Cowork plugin. All content is fictional sample data for demonstration only; outputs are drafts for counsel review and are not legal advice.
